caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a staff or rod with a sculpted horse's head at the top. The horse's head is detailed, facing left, and appears carved or molded in a grayish tone, with visible features such as ears, eyes, nostrils, and a flowing mane. Below the horse's head is a circular, decorative collar with a fluted or beaded design, followed by a simple, smooth cylindrical shaft that is consistent in diameter and dark gray in color. The artist's name, "HILDA OLSON," is printed in small capitals in the lower right corner of the image. There are some scattered brownish marks and smudges on the background, possibly due to age or the texture of the paper.
title: Horse Head Hitching Post
